text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm, she's gotten considerably faster.
Faster, yes... however...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
D-Damn it... I swung out way too wide on the corner.
My braking seems off...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Huh? Why are you pulling back...?
I don't remember giving that order... Hey, wait...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Like... she goes totally out of control sometimes, doesn't she?
Her finer movements aren't great either.
choice_data_list: Yeah, compared to living flesh, that is.
Yeah, compared to flesh and blood, that is.

text_block_list.text: As expected, getting it to move as freely as my original body is proving quite difficult...

Without those subtle maneuvers, though,
you can't feel at one with your ride,
and ultimately you'll never reach top speed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It seems there are still many challenges to overcome in order to attain both freedom and performance...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehehehe, khahaha!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: What? What's wrong, Gimlet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: If it cannot achieve complete resonance with its mimicked body—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Fall, into the mundane world.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Meaning what?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Forget the struggles of the gods and make merry, she says.
In other words—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: In the garden of delight!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
An arcade, huh.
Not a place I visit often, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Does playing around in a place like this
serve any purpose?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see...
That might be a good way to bring the Doctor
and ST-2 closer to true unison.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it means this: if Dr. Wrights
rarely comes to this place, then...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it is a place where
'one performs movements outside their normal routine.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The more we adapt to irregular movements,
the closer the Professor and ST-2 will become as one."

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: I see. Gimlet's words may be hard to grasp, but they hit the mark.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Then what kind of game should I play?
Trainer, do you have any recommendations?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
A rhythm game, huh. I see.
It demands a completely different set of movements compared to running.
choice_data_list: Yes, this is exactly what we need right now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Let's do it then. I'll join you.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Mmh, heh, hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Piece of junk...
Not like that. Make it sharper...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
ST-2... Wait, Professor,
didn't you learn dancing back when you were at Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I learned it... all the basics, at least...
Not only was I bad at it, though...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I've never danced in a prominent position before.
I've only ever been a back dancer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. But if you lack experience, that only means
you have that much more room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then build up your experience and gather more data.
Next up is Hard Mode. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Uggghhh...

And so, after playing to our hearts' content
at the arcade...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: "Do we... play with this stick? Like poking Gimlet and Kris S?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a joust? That could be entertaining.
Let us see who gets thrown from their unicorn first.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Neither.
What we're playing is—billiards.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Billiards... Striking those rolling balls,
correct? Please teach me the rules.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. First, the bullet is 'Unwavering White.'
Let's see if you can submerge the nine expiations
into the vortex of sin!"

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: ...Make it simple, please.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Explaining things... isn't my strong suit, but...

I explained in their stead:
you hit the white cue ball into the lowest-numbered ball,
and ultimately sink the 9-ball to win.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Trainer. Concise and easy to understand.
I've got it.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: It's tough to be precise with an unfamiliar movement, but... I'll give it a shot.
(Tink... Clang clang clang!)
Clearing numerous games I'd never played before together with my friends, and then—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Tooooooooh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
This is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
She's gotten faster. Way faster than before...
To think she could change this much...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: I did it, I did it, Trainer!

Having her play a variety of games seems to have
vastly improved her movements. What's more—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"Getting to hang out with everyone was, well... a good experience.
It's not easy socializing from a wheelchair, you know."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That makes sense.
Going out to have fun in a wheelchair probably comes with limits and worries. But ST-2 allows us to overcome even those barriers.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Everyone, if you don't mind, though...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Could you continue taking ST-2 and me
to all kinds of places from now on?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: I'd... appreciate that. It would help a lot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I mean... it goes without saying.
